---
title: "Tutorial"
description: "A linear SCNSim course from primitive circuit authoring to reusable Direct, optimization, and HB workflows."
---

The SCNSim Tutorial follows one rule: **if an API has not been taught, the
course does not use it.** Each page starts with a real circuit-modeling need,
introduces only the objects needed to solve it, and finishes with a complete
inspectable workflow.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Candidate package

SCNSim remains `CONVERGING`. The code in this course expresses the intended V1
UX, but the current package is a fail-fast scaffold and does not yet simulate a
circuit.
:::

## Follow the course in order

| Part | Starting need | Prerequisites | Main objects introduced | Produced surface |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [1. Build a complete circuit from primitives](../examples/simple_resonator/01_model_author.qmd) | Understand every branch in a one-port reflective resonator | None | units, primitive R/L/C-style components, `CircuitPlan`, nodes, ground, Port, diagram, Run, View, Direct solve/evaluate, Results | authoring diagram, Direct S/Y/Z, root quantity, report |
| [2. Package the LC as a reusable Composite](../examples/reusable_composite/01_composite_plan.qmd) | Stop rebuilding the same resonator internals | Part 1 | immutable custom `Library`, `CompositePlan`, public parameters, exposed pin, `ComponentInstance` | reusable grounded-resonator component |
| [3. Publish and use a team-owned model](../examples/simple_resonator/02_model_user.qmd) | Let teammates use an owned model without restating topology or analysis choices | Parts 1–2 | target, optimization variables/objectives, default recipe, team façade, workspace, exact resolve | optimization Result through a reusable model boundary |
| [4. Author an optimization-ready IPF Composite](../examples/ipf_optimization/01_model_author.qmd) | Assemble coupled transmission-line sections and calibrated lumped mappings once | Parts 1–3 | general RLGC, Q2D input, transmission lines, IDC, fan-out, `AffineMap`, `CoordinateRef`, PTC, quantity selectors, compiled diagram, explain | sealed IPF model and inspectable default request |
| [5. Optimize once and reuse the winner](../examples/ipf_optimization/02_model_user.qmd) | Reuse one optimized ParameterSet across Direct and pump-off HB analysis | Parts 1–4 | override/extrapolation, best parameters, HB axes/drives/cases/truncation, case Results, display, report, resolve | optimization, winner Direct/HB Results, durable report |

Tutorial pages explain the API needed for their workflow. Deeper design
reasoning lives under [Concept](concepts/physical-authority-and-reusable-composition.qmd),
while exact signatures, formulas, invariants, failures, and evidence live under
[Contract](component-authoring.qmd).

## Choose a different reading layer

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .border .rounded .p-3}
### Understand the design

Read [Physical authority and reusable composition](concepts/physical-authority-and-reusable-composition.qmd),
then continue through the Concept sidebar. These pages explain the pressures
behind Plans, immutable views, typed requests, and explicit ownership.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .border .rounded .p-3}
### Review exact behavior

Use the [Component Authoring Contract](component-authoring.qmd) and
[V1 Runtime Contract](v1-runtime-contract.qmd) when a signature, physical
boundary, failure mode, receipt field, or open Human decision must be exact.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## Human acceptance remains explicit

Package import, CI, Quarto rendering, and review can reject malformed candidate
bytes. They cannot accept SCNSim semantics or promote this development package
to a stable product line.
:::
